outcome_source_auth.message: The source sign-in expired or access was denied. Sign in directly on the source platform, then have this result reviewed before another transfer.

outcome_receipt_invalid.message: TGP did not return a valid transfer receipt. The affected batch needs reconciliation, not a blind retry.

outcome_settlement_failed.message: The final status could not be confirmed. Earlier transfer receipts are retained below.

outcome_source_incomplete.message: Some source pages could not be read. Their record counts are unknown.

outcome_interrupted_detail.message: The transfer stopped before every result could be confirmed. Preserve this summary for review.

outcome_receipt.message: $RECEIVED$ confirmed received: $INSERTED$ newly staged, $DEDUPED$ with no new row.

outcome_unconfirmed.message: $COUNT$ unconfirmed. They may already have reached TGP; do not retry blindly.

outcome_coverage.message: Missing-record count is unknown. Unread pages or unsupported data may contain more records.

outcome_native.message: These are transfer receipts, not verified clients or history ready to use in TGP.

outcome_no_receipt.message: No detailed transfer receipts are available. This does not prove that nothing was written.

outcome_guidance.message: Keep this result. Copy the summary for TGP support before another transfer. Automatic recovery is not available yet.

outcome_running_guidance.message: Check status to see the latest recorded progress. A new transfer is blocked here to protect this result.

outcome_summary_heading.message: TGP importer: local transfer summary (not verified migration)

outcome_checked.message: Local status checked. This does not verify server recovery.

outcome_check_failed.message: Could not check status. Your last displayed result is unchanged.

outcome_copied.message: Summary copied. No client details or credentials included.

outcome_copy_failed.message: Could not copy. You can select and copy the visible result instead.

start_import_unconfirmed.message: Start was not confirmed. Check the importer status before trying again.
start_import_unconfirmed.description: A lost or unsuccessful Start reply does not prove that no work ran.

replay_staging_counts.message: $RECEIVED$ received: $INSERTED$ new staged, $DEDUPED$ no new row
replay_staging_counts.description: Backend staging acknowledgements, not verified native records; no-new-row does not prove correct deduplication.

replay_notify_staged.message: Records from $PLATFORM$ were staged in TGP. Migration is not verified. Review the importer status.
replay_notify_staged.description: Successful receipt is not proof of native records or complete business migration.

replay_status_staged.message: Transfer staged. Migration is not verified.
replay_status_staged.description: Label for legacy ingest_succeeded state; never imply native migration completion.

replay_partial_skipped.description: Partial import reason: malformed responses or exhausted request retries.

replay_partial_budget.description: Partial import reason: additional work exceeds a configured safety budget.

replay_partial_pagination_cycle.description: Partial import reason: a page URL was repeated before exhaustion was proved.

replay_partial_page_ceiling.message: pagination reached the safe page-number ceiling
replay_partial_page_ceiling.description: Partial import reason: the next page number would exceed the safe integer range.

replay_partial_incomplete.description: Fallback reason when no recognized partial-import category is present.

replay_partial_summary.message: partial import ($REASONS$) — $COUNT$ record(s) received. Migration is not complete. Contact TGP support with this warning before retrying.
replay_partial_summary.description: Bounded warning and recovery guidance; receiving records does not mean native migration is complete.
